steps.content: Nino's explosive power destroyed everything. The space returns to its initial state, white and spotless.

steps.speaker: Shadow
steps.content: Your power is truly astonishing.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Of course! I was a survivor in your world!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Don't think I won't recognize your voice just because you've turned into a shadow!!
Nino launches an attack on the shadow in the white space, but her opponent doesn't dodge or flinch. It takes the hit and breaks into dust in the air.

steps.speaker: Shadow
steps.content: You ignored the audience's voice, acted so egotistically, and even tried to pit the viewers against each other...

steps.speaker: Shadow
steps.content: You really are terrifying. Locking you in here away from them is the right decision.

steps.speaker: Shadow
steps.content: You will stay, and when this world attains its ideal form like in my dreams... you will change along with it...
As it speaks, the shadow slowly fades away, leaving only its giggles echoing throughout this space.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: ******* bastard!

steps.speaker: Shadow
steps.content: Oh, are you mad? You'd better not get too worked up, after all... you're still live... Listen to the audience... or...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Live?
Nino looks around and finds that this white space is still that screen from the very beginning. She's indeed still under the streaming setup.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: No... It's not just me who's live...
Nino takes two steps forward and finds that the wall has become transparent in an instant.
What she sees astonishes her. She's looking at ${PlayerName} and Eleven! The two of them walk into the TV station, into a room full of screens!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Hey!!! You two!!! I'm here!! Can't you hear me?!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Why won't they respond to me?! Why can't they see me!!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Please... let me go with you!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I won't lie anymore. I'll tell you my true feelings!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Look at me!!!
But the two people outside can't hear nor see Nino at all. They showed no response to her.
Nino can only watch as they repeatedly fall into crisis and escape from danger narrowly.
Nino hears the faint, bewitching female voice again.

steps.speaker: Shadow
steps.content: See... this is what happens when you don't listen to the audience. This is... how it feels when your voice receives no response at all.

steps.speaker: Shadow
steps.content: Isn't it so... sad and painful?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Yes... It feels terrible, like being ignored, like I'm transparent in front of them.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I understand this feeling too well...

steps.speaker: Shadow
steps.content: ...What are you going to do?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Of course... I'm going to break this ******* piece of crap!!!
Standing in front of the screen, Nino suddenly roars and activates her power again.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I've been defying you since the very moment I entered this world. Do you really think your little trick can trap me?!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Didn't you see? Those two idiots are getting bullied without my help!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Just you wait!! Nino Sama is on her way!!!!
The moment Nino activates her skill, numerous beams of red light suddenly flood into this white space.
A determined yet gentle emotion suddenly emerges within her, as if she's in a warm embrace and under an affectionate gaze.
Remember what kind of voices you wanted in the very beginning.
Voices? When I first started streaming, what kind of voices did I want to hear?
Praise? Slander? Or mere attention?
Before losing consciousness, Nino suddenly remembers something.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I... remember that comment...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I... think it said...
Please keep playing. I'd be overjoyed if I can play with you!
